What each entry records

The source is the original numbered example. Its working copy links to the matching entry. The first two snapshots record the original wording, source and limits of each transfer description. They were prepared on November 14, 2026. The third snapshot, logged November 16, 2026, appends the later findings. The lists record no dated instance of water moving along any of these routes.

For physical events in this garden, all 36 entries are unverified. Each has source tier seven and a human-source-and-evidence value of zero. Factual strength remains unassessed. There is no approval to freeze the evidence register.
